text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills slipped to 48.58 percent from 49.39 percent at the last sale on October 31, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 6.49 million UAH 3.58 million UAH
Actual amount raised 5.22 million UAH 2.88 million UAH
The central bank sold 64,960 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for November 12.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills edged up to 58.26 from 58.12 percent at the last sale on October 31, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 11.44 million UAH 3.23 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.97 million UAH 2.25 million UAH
The central bank sold 114,433 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for November 12.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills stood at 60.94 percent, the same as at the last sale on October 31, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 3,456 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for November 12. --Kiev newsroom +380 44 229-2264
